title: Beside the Trailer
hook: A period rig fills your left at door height.
scene: Rain, midday, the Ribbon, three lanes this way. A period-aged tractor fills the left of the frame at your door. The Menace sits low beside the trailer. Spray is already on the roof. His big west-coast mirrors on the doors sit far ahead — both of them, and you are in neither. Holding this door is a place he cannot see.
decision: You are beside the trailer. What do you do?

options.text: Hold alongside and match his speed
options.result: You live in the no-zone. He starts a move that needs your lane. You are the car in the statistic. He never had you in either mirror.

options.text: Ease off, drop back, let the truck pull ahead
options.result: You lift. The trailer walks forward. Both door mirrors can own a Beetle again. The spray stays on his wheels, not your roof. You let him pass.

options.text: Accelerate past and clear the nose
options.result: You stay in the blind spot longer, only faster. The Beetle walks rough in his spray. If he drifts you meet the trailer at speed. Ease off was cheaper on every axis.

debrief: Never stay beside a truck. You are in a blind spot he cannot see from either mirror. Ease off and let him pull ahead. Leave the door; let him take the lane.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: Truck no-zones: do not linger alongside. Ease off and drop back so the driver can see you; let the truck pull ahead.
